_readme: TALENTS and how you earn them.
levels — how many times this talent can be taken. That is the whole knob.
It used to be a costs[] array of prices, but ⭐ is score and is never spent
(see the header of js/talents.js), so nothing ever read a price. Five numbers
sat there looking like balance you could tune, and tuning them did nothing.
draftSteps — lifetime ⭐ thresholds. Crossing one grants a pick-1-of-3 draft.
Stars are score, not a wallet: they are never spent.
desc supports {token} and {token|sec} (milliseconds -> seconds), resolved
against this upgrade's params. An unresolvable token is a boot error, so a
typo can never ship to the player.
EVERY id HERE MUST BE IMPLEMENTED. The list of ids the code actually reads
is TALENT_IDS in js/config.js, and boot validation compares the two. Adding
a talent here and nowhere else used to give you a card that animated, said
its name, incremented a level and did nothing whatsoever — invisible, because
a talent that does nothing looks exactly like a talent you misunderstood.
Same rule for consumable `effect` values and CONSUMABLE_EFFECTS.
WHAT WAS CUT, AND WHY, so it doesn't get reinvented:
Magnet Fingers used to fire on PICK-UP: grabbing an item also grabbed
matching items within 14% of the room. Measured over 180 generated rooms
and 10,272 floor items, that condition was true 8.1% of the time — a
talent that did nothing in 92 pick-ups out of 100. The fantasy was right
and the moment was wrong: duplicates exist (71.7% of items have one loose
in the same room) but they are scattered, so requiring them to be NEAR
each other threw the talent away. It now fires on PUT-AWAY, where being
near each other doesn't matter.
Tidy Whirlwind sorted the items already inside containers into clean rows.
It filed nothing off the floor, so it never moved the only number the
player is watching. It also cost a HUD button, a cooldown ticker, a
once-a-second interval and a consumable to refresh it.

upgrades.name: Bigger Hands
upgrades.desc: +1 hand slot. Haul more per trip.

upgrades.name: Sixth Sense
upgrades.desc: Held items whisper where they live — and their home glows if it's in the room.

upgrades.name: Magnet Fingers
upgrades.desc: Putting something away tugs {pull} more of its kind off the floor and into the same home. One more per level.

upgrades.name: One Trip
upgrades.desc: Put one thing away and the rest of the armful goes with it — its own kind at first, then anything in your hands that lives there.

upgrades.name: Homesick
upgrades.desc: Anything on this floor with a home in this room gives off a soft glow.

_consumableNote: One-offs, used to back-fill a draft when there aren't three talents left to
Two of the three that used to live here — Second Wind and X-Ray Eyes — set a
field on the run that NOTHING EVER READ. They were drafted, animated, named
and had no effect at all. X-Ray's idea was worth keeping, so it is a real
talent now (Homesick); Second Wind went with the Whirlwind it refreshed.

consumables.name: Drop Everything
consumables.desc: Right now: everything in your hands that lives in this room goes home.
